name: paradoc-react
author: paradoc
abstract: Compose, check, preview, render and seal Paradoc documents written in React with @paradoc/react and @paradoc/react-pdf: install components and blocks from the @paradoc registry, bind a composition to a form artifact through its React layer, stay inside the verified class vocabulary the PDF engine renders, check with paradoc check, preview with paradoc dev, render with renderPdf, and seal through the React layer renderers.
